slice_scope_ref.slice_name: component design planning service initial implementation proof slice

component_assignment.component_role: domain service that interprets structured component design into planning-ready outputs for brief derivation and producer-side authoring flows

required_architecture_seams: Keep Component Design Planning Service in the Domain Services layer.
Keep brief assembly, sequencing, and producer orchestration outside this service.
target_module_boundaries: Implement service logic inside the component_design_planning service package.
Do not move raw SQL, packet assembly, or workflow semantics into this service.
Add unit tests through a dedicated service test module rather than piggybacking on repository tests.
forbidden_module_growth_patterns: Do not turn this service into a producer-side orchestrator.
Do not add raw SQL or direct DB configuration handling.
Do not silently extend the realization taxonomy from inside service implementation code.

sequencing_notes: This brief is now bound to a real Stage 1 DesignPackage and work item.
Service-oriented code-artifact target taxonomy is now available for this slice.
Keep this service slice isolated from producer orchestration and runtime-adoption work.
Treat this artifact as governed draft authority until review approval and packet-readiness checks are completed.

runtime_inputs: optional coder brief realization target context
forbidden_hidden_dependencies: Do not depend on direct SQL execution.
Do not depend on GitHub issue or PR state.
Do not depend on workflow-state or runtime-event repositories.
Do not depend on installed execution package file reads.

behavior_to_add_or_change: Resolve one component by stable identity.
Load and normalize component element planning data.
Load allowed realization-type options for relevant component elements.
Load current realization instances for relevant component elements.
Build structured planning views and planning gaps for downstream brief assembly.
invariants_to_preserve: The service remains stateless between calls.
The service does not mutate component-design persistence by default.
The service does not invent realization targets outside the known taxonomy.
The service returns structured planning outputs rather than prose-only summaries.
edge_cases: Component exists but has no component elements.
Component element exists but has no allowed realization types.
Partial realization instances exist and planning output must still remain coherent.
error_conditions: Repository lookup fails or returns ambiguous component identity.
Controlled taxonomy needed for planning is missing.
Requested planning payload cannot be built without required component-design records.

protected_baseline_checks: Existing ComponentDesignRepository tests continue to pass.
No raw SQL is added to the service package.
No producer or consumer runtime entrypoints change in this slice.

dependency_readiness: component design repository read slice implemented
blocking_causes: No approved brief authority exists yet for this slice.
No packet-ready execution authority exists yet for this slice.
Brief-target realization instances and producer-side review flow are not yet materialized for this proof slice.

change_budget.max_responsibility_expansion: Implement Component Design Planning Service only; do not absorb brief assembly, orchestration, workflow, or persistence ownership.
pre_handoff_scope_checks: Only the component_design_planning service package and its dedicated tests changed.
No producer or consumer host wiring changed in this slice.

anti_goals: Do not implement Brief Assembly Service here.
Do not implement producer-side orchestration or packet preparation here.
Do not mutate component-design persistence by default.
Do not smuggle taxonomy extensions into service implementation code.
common_failure_modes: The service becomes a producer-side workflow blob instead of a narrow domain service.
Repository access and raw SQL leak into the service.
The implementation invents service artifact targets that the current taxonomy cannot represent or govern.
Unit tests are skipped and repository tests are treated as sufficient proof.
